scope: Complete original AC-010 under frozen C003, REQ-005.5/.6, current Linux M1 snapshot/file contract

conditions.condition: Fixed current source, tests and reviewed product documentation
conditions.judgment: Git trees and all 187 src, 4 native, 17 test working files match fixed main and executed e002; tests also match reviewed 234a. README bytes match reviewed ebf exactly. 80d/ecbf code/build-input delta is empty.

conditions.condition: One compatible public API and common renderer
conditions.judgment: Application.snapshot retains width,height and optional glyphMode=Unicode; old two-argument consumer compiles. Frame serializers/file methods keep the declared signatures. Runtime produce uses existing renderLayout/Frame composition, with no second product renderer or Unicode table.

conditions.condition: Current stable committed main tree and layers
conditions.judgment: snapshot requires the outer UI boundary, enters the owning session, pumps a fixed invalidation cutoff and stabilizes pending work before produce. stabilize commits groups/viewport commands; renderLayout consumes overlayRecords and current geometry. Covered observable change is visible outside the modal, then fully visible after closing parent and child.

conditions.condition: Visible nested modal/nonmodal layers, transparency and styled spaces
conditions.judgment: Manual full-cell/style grids distinguish Canvas unpainted hole from blue bold space. Nested modal underline/inverse area replaces parent; parent closure closes child. Independent file oracle reconstructs those exact grids from an empty screen.

Rounded border and dim shadow are in complete literal grids; changing target width moves centered layer, shrinking its component clips the wide glyph safely, closure restores current base without stale shadow. Movement tested through actual layout recentering, not a nonexistent move API.

conditions.condition: Current viewport and complete wide-cell semantics
conditions.judgment: Horizontal viewport exercises right cut, whole wide glyph, left cut, scroll behind transparent overlay and content shrink. Exact Frame cell assertions include continuation,width,style,opacity; clipping yields spaces and preserves neighboring cells. Source applies pending viewport ensures before final layer geometry and painting.

conditions.condition: Retained snapshot object not modified by later application changes
conditions.judgment: The same stored Frame objects are checked and exported after glyph/content, layer, viewport and decoration updates. old files equal the original grids. produce returns cached.copy; copy allocates its own cell array and transfers value Cells. This is isolation from later application changes, not a claim that the public mutable Frame API is immutable.

conditions.condition: Unicode default, offline Auto and explicit Ascii generated markers
conditions.judgment: Application configured Ascii still yields Unicode default snapshot; default/Auto/Unicode literal rows are éBC… while explicit Ascii is é.... Business 中 and combining e remain unchanged. offlineGlyphPolicy maps only Ascii to Ascii and all other offline modes to Unicode. No extra offline border-transcoding promise is inferred.

conditions.condition: Headless export performs no flush or device probing
conditions.judgment: Public consumers use startHeadless, snapshot and dispose with no flush/run. Their captured output has no ESC, terminalGlyphCapabilities remains None. Concrete snapshot->pump->produce->renderLayout path contains no present/write/probe; serializers take an explicit offline profile rather than device capabilities. Source proof covers the internal absence not observable as an API event.

conditions.condition: Whole independent ANSI target with complete cells/styles
conditions.judgment: toAnsi is the full-frame path, with explicit row positioning and reset boundaries; it does not consume a previous frame. Reviewed finite test oracle starts blank every call, requires every target cell touched, verifies all manual cells/styles and rejects omissions/device controls. Actual validator exit zero covers all exported targets including trailing spaces and wide continuations.

conditions.condition: Logical files independent of stdout capabilities and history
conditions.judgment: snapshotProfile explicitly constructs the offline TrueColor/default attribute+Unicode profile; file output uses it, not lastCapabilities or terminal projection state. Raw truecolor RGB and Unicode survive piped headless stdout. Monochrome exports preserve attributes/text while dropping colors. Source separates changesSinceForTerminal from toAnsi.

conditions.condition: UTF-8 complete plain grid with no ESC and defined line endings
conditions.judgment: Formal first-slice and composition contracts specify full columns, no duplicated wide continuation, LF between rows and no extra terminal LF. File bytes are compared against hand literal UTF-8 rows, not against exporter-generated expectations; accented, combining, CJK and ZWJ text exercise encoding. All plain files are checked for ESC absence.

Default blanks and blue bold overlay space are explicit cells; theme seed background fills blank cells, local background carries inverse/underline over all three cells. ANSI oracle verifies reset start/end and exact per-cell styles. Plain text intentionally removes style while retaining spaces; product guide plus formal contracts define these semantics.

run.sh seeds all export paths with 4096 z bytes before the consumer. Exact byte/semantic validator then passes shorter exports. Zero width 0x2 plain is one LF, zero height/both plain empty, and all zero-axis ANSI empty; thus truncation includes zero-byte outputs. Frame dimensions are checked before writing.

Both file APIs produce actual SDK exceptions for directory, missing parent, embedded NUL, denied directory and /dev/full. uid1000 plus mode0500 and nonwritable guard make permission failure real. No truncated NUL path is created. File methods propagate File.writeTo failures without catch/swallow.

conditions.condition: Positive-prefix short writes reported without atomic-replacement promise
conditions.judgment: Native launcher uses RLIMIT_FSIZE=32 and ignores SIGXFSZ, then execs the same public consumer. Both actual regular files contain 32 bytes and both APIs throw. The nonempty plain and ANSI prefixes were inspected. Partial files remain, exactly within C003's explicit no-atomic-replacement promise.

conditions.condition: Usable product viewing conditions and actual-host examples
conditions.judgment: Reviewed product README now states UTF-8/CUP/SGR, sufficient dimensions, concrete clear/home/cat/reset/CUP commands, color choice, plain-text alternative and font/host limits. Original XTerm398 and XFCE1.1.4/VTE0.80.1 PNGs were independently viewed; strace confirms exact documented controls around the same 49-byte theme-local 3x1 file in actual 80x25 windows. This demonstrates a small offline replay only; the documented 80x24 example file was not generated.

conditions.condition: Independent review/execution and appropriately scoped reuse
conditions.judgment: Reviewed fixed test source and doc addition match main. Traced unmodified CLI set-e/pipefail reaches its final printf with exit0 after build, direct binary, short-write exec and validator. Existing normal bundle exit0 is reused only for unchanged 80d/ecbf code/dependencies/build configuration under AGENTS11.1.
